For each nonempty I, conditional Laplace integration over the B_j gives b_I; E_i with F_j for i≠j are mutually exclusive, whereas E_i and F_i use disjoint variables and contribute b_i² as the only mixed two-facet removal. Inclusion-exclusion yields the four displayed probabilities, N∈{3,4,5,6}, and E[N]=6-2u1.
